_about: Key regulatory facts register. Edit with _scripts/update_fact.py, then run sync_layout.py. Pages show a fact by wrapping it in …; build_facts.py keeps every copy identical to this file. checked.how is one of: official (read on the official source), auto (found on the official source by the weekly watch), expert (confirmed by the site's expert reviewer), secondary (checked only through secondary sources such as law firm summaries or search results). Optional 'exclude' phrases stop build_facts.py --wrap from linking look-alike mentions (same value, different fact). Set "autocheck": false (with an "autocheck_note") for facts whose official page can't be read automatically; they are then re-checked by hand on the normal timetable.
